customAgents.name: Plan Agent
customAgents.description: React Planning Agent — sets up git branch, reads the project, and generates plan.md + control.md for a ticket

customAgents.name: Develop Agent
customAgents.description: React Development Agent — implements an approved plan slice by slice and tracks progress in development.md

customAgents.name: Test Agent
customAgents.description: React Test Agent — generates unit and integration tests, runs them, and reports results in testcases.md

customAgents.name: Review Agent
customAgents.description: React Review Agent — reviews all branch changes against the plan and React best practices, outputs a structured review report

customAgents.name: Impact Agent
customAgents.description: React Impact Agent — analyses branch changes against develop to surface side effects, regression risks, shared code blast radius, and merge confidence rating before a PR is raised

customAgents.name: Document Agent
customAgents.description: Document Agent — writes clear, layperson-friendly documentation for a feature or ticket and saves it to ai-dev/<ticket-number>/documentation.md

customAgents.name: PR Description Agent
customAgents.description: PR Description Agent — generates a structured pull request title and body from plan.md, ticket artefacts, and git diff; saves to ai-dev/<ticket-number>/pr-description.md

customAgents.name: Release Doc Agent
customAgents.description: Release Doc Agent — merges per-ticket documentation.md files into ai-doc/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md for token-efficient AI orientation

customAgents.name: Commit Agent
customAgents.description: Commit Agent — stages branch changes, drafts a conventional commit message, and requires explicit human approval before git commit (see staged-commit-approval skill)
